findings.title: All twelve success criteria have corresponding tasks and verification coverage
findings.description:
Cross-reference of the slice design's Success Criteria against the task file:
- SC1 (flow selection) → Task 1 (authored), 1.2 + 8.5 (verified live).
- SC2 (two fixed questions + single confirmation, extraction first) → Tasks 5.1/5.2, fidelity check 5.3 (byte-identical diff), timing/interaction inventory re-checked in 8.1.
- SC3 (attribution rules per source) → Task 3.1–3.3 with 3.4 executed against this repo; `[INFERRED]` rule in 7.1.
- SC4 (dropped topics nowhere) → Task 4.1 states the rule and 4.2 verifies it against the design.
- SC5 (declined-question semantics) → Task 5.1; verified in the 8.2 decline path.
- SC6 (verbatim answers, preservation, dated append) → Task 5.1 (verbatim landing) + 6.1 (write rules); verified 8.1 (diff against answers) and 8.4 (byte-identical `git diff` on augment).
- SC7 (loud stop on guide failure) → Task 6.1 with its two distinct stop messages; failure path exercised in 8.3 against a scratch copy.
- SC8 (never overwrite; default stop; refillability) → Task 6.2; verified 8.4.
- SC9 (frontmatter + filename divergence) → Task 7.2; `cf validate frontmatter` and the `squadron`/`squadron-ai` checks in 8.1.
- SC10 (provenance outcome set, inferred-claims) → Tasks 7.1/7.3; provenance lines checked in 8.1.
- SC11 (read discipline, single changed non-document file) → Task 3.1 (discipline statement) and 8.6 (`git diff --name-only main`, `git diff --stat main -- src/`, clean `.understand-anything/`).
- SC12 (PM would edit, not discard) → the 8.1 happy path produces and inspects the real document.
Tasks 8.2–8.6 extend beyond the design's own walkthrough (which has 7 steps), covering decline, contract-failure, re-run, live selection, and discipline — no scope creep into excluded areas (364/366, `src/squadron/`, the guide file itself are untouched and 8.6's diff check enforces this).

findings.title: Commit markers use checklist form instead of plain `**Commit**:` lines
findings.description: All eight commit markers (lines 99, 125, 164, 185, 221, 254, 296, 351) are checkbox items (`- [ ] Commit: ...`) rather than plain `**Commit**:` lines. The placement itself is correct — markers sit at working, tested points after each authoring-plus-verify pair, and one after the walkthrough (8.6), not after every task and not only at the end. The format is a cosmetic deviation from the marker convention; consider converting them to plain lines so task-checker does not treat them as checkable work items.

findings.title: No document-level check that dropped topics are absent from the generated concept
findings.description: SC4 requires dropped topics (why-now, audience evolution, methodology preference) to appear nowhere in the written document. Tasks 4.1/4.2 establish and verify the rule in the skill text, and 5.3 confirms no third question exists in the flow, but the 8.1 checklist does not include a line confirming the generated `000-concept.squadron.md` contains no dropped-topic content or gap markers. The design's own walkthrough omits this too, so the task file mirrors the design; a one-line addition to 8.1 would close the loop cheaply. Not blocking — the authoring tasks make the omission structurally unlikely.
